yields_meta.name: Food
yields_meta.note: District foodgrain production 2022-23 (DES crop production statistics; rice, wheat, coarse cereals, pulses), spread inside each district by hex cropland area (MODIS 2023). District sums run above the national estimate (for example rice 148.6 Mt against 135.8 Mt), so compare places, not totals.

yields_meta.name: Production
yields_meta.note: Industrial GSVA (mining, manufacturing, electricity/gas/water, construction), 2023-24, MoSPI. Spread inside each state by Census 2011 non-farm workers (household industry + other workers). The spread is a model.

yields_meta.name: Gold
yields_meta.note: Gross State Domestic Product 2023-24 at current prices (MoSPI), spread inside each state by Census 2011 non-farm workers. Check against Maharashtra's official district GDP 2022-23 (33 districts): log correlation r = 0.99, median error 9%. Night lights as the weight did worse (r = 0.52, median error 41%), because the Black Marble image saturates in big cities.

yields_meta.name: Science
yields_meta.note: Graduates and above in the Census 2011 education table, spread over each district's hexes by area. Universities and research institutes appear as campus resources on the map.

yields_meta.name: Culture
yields_meta.unit: heritage points (UNESCO site = 10, natural = 5, museum = 2, ASI monument = 1)
yields_meta.note: UNESCO World Heritage Sites and protected monuments with an ASI monument ID in Wikidata (2,913 centrally protected of about 3,700, plus 1,571 state-protected) located in the hex. Wikidata coverage differs between states, so low counts can mean missing records.

yields_meta.name: Faith
yields_meta.note: Protected monuments (ASI monument ID in Wikidata) whose Wikidata class is a place of worship, stupa, monastery or dargah (P31/P279*), located in the hex. This counts protected religious heritage buildings; it does not measure religious practice or belief. Wikidata coverage differs between states.

yields_meta.name: Health
yields_meta.note: Hex pips: mean percentile of six NFHS-5 (2019–21) district indicators — institutional births, full immunisation, sanitation, insurance (higher is better) and stunting, anaemia in women (lower is better). State totals: public hospital beds (district, sub-district hospitals and medical colleges, RHS 2025).

yields_meta.name: Infrastructure
yields_meta.note: Hex score: power capacity (GW) + airport passengers (millions) + port cargo (10 Mt units) in the hex. State totals: installed power-plant capacity in the WRI Global Power Plant Database (2019).

model_note:
Civilization mechanics: yields, city footprints and specialisations, resources, wonders,
history pass-through and advisor observations. Every number traces to a normalized dataset.

YIELD MODEL (also written into nation.json for the Almanac)
Each yield has one primary real-world indicator with real units (state and national totals)
and a hex model that spreads it across hexes with a documented weight:
  food        foodgrain production (crop_state)         weight: hex cropland share (MODIS 2023)
  production  industrial GSVA: mining+mfg+elec+constr   weight: Census 2011 non-farm workers in the hex
  gold        GSDP current prices (gsdp_state)          weight: Census 2011 non-farm workers (validated on Maharashtra district GDP)
  science     graduates (Census 2011)                   direct: district counts spread by area
  culture     heritage sites (UNESCO + ASI + museums)   direct: points in the hex
  faith       religious heritage sites                  direct: points in the hex
  health      public hospital beds (RHS 2025)           hex pips use the NFHS-5 health index instead
  infrastructure power capacity, airports, ports        direct: points in the hex
Hex pips (0–4) are quintiles of the hex value per km² among land hexes with data (0 = no data or
bottom 20 %). Pips compare hexes; they are not units.
